defect: a reset synchronizer release signal is consumed as ordinary data in another clock domain

mutation.description: The clk_ctrl reset-release indication is wired directly into a clk_data enable condition without destination synchronisation.

rationale: The release_ctrl transition is only aligned to clk_ctrl and can be sampled metastably by clk_data; its use as a data-domain enable is not a reset pin exemption.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.note: Reset release synchronized to the control clock is reused as raw functional data enable in an unrelated clock domain.
